mentions.name: Review Box
mentions.description: A tool for helping with GitHub Pull Requests. It includes an integrated dashboard showing what to review, integrated symbol understanding, a clear split of reviewed and unreviewed files, and a result diff view that shows only how files will look in the end, letting the author avoid opening GitHub directly.
mentions.audience: Developers working with GitHub pull requests; built for the author's own use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the last year, I've been working on Review Box https://review-box.rstankov.com/ on the side. It is a tool to help me with GitHub Pull Requests.
mentions.author: rado_stankov
